fib: ______ are used to educate the tactile sense; thermic and aural education is provided by asking the children to feel various textured articles, and listening to sounds of cylinders.
Touch boards
Touch boards are used to educate the tactile sense; thermic and aural education is provided by asking the children to feel various textured articles, and listening to sounds of cylinders.
______ is the functional level of learning, at which children can apply or make use of their understanding of events, objects, people or concepts.
Utilization
Utilization is the functional level of learning, at which children can apply or make use of their understanding of events, objects, people or concepts.
______ is used, the type of materials available in the sand play area will influence the kind of play activities the children engage in.
Whatever container
Whatever container is used, the type of materials available in the sand play area will influence the kind of play activities the children engage in.
______ is a sound pre-condition for social development.
Heterogeneous grouping
Heterogeneous grouping is a sound pre-condition for social development.
______ refers to the child's ability not to respond to a stimulus which is different from the one for which the response was originally learned.
Discrimination
Discrimination refers to the child's ability not to respond to a stimulus which is different from the one for which the response was originally learned.
______ refers to the phenomenon where the same response is learned for an entire class of situations or events.
Concept learning
Concept learning refers to the phenomenon where the same response is learned for an entire class of situations or events.
______ is a gradual process where successive approximations to the desired behaviour are rewarded until the final behaviour appears.
Shaping
Shaping is a gradual process where successive approximations to the desired behaviour are rewarded until the final behaviour appears.
______ is a very vital aspect of development as the child experiences increasingly complex levels of functioning and behaviour at each successive stage of maturation.
Learning
Learning is a very vital aspect of development as the child experiences increasingly complex levels of functioning and behaviour at each successive stage of maturation.
______ is used to observe how well a particular response has been learned and it also shows that the learned behaviour can be unlearned.
process of extinction
The process of extinction is used to observe how well a particular response has been learned and it also shows that the learned behaviour can be unlearned.
______ refer to those factors that lie outside the child.
Phenotypic factors
Phenotypic factors refer to those factors that lie outside the child.
